name: Dorei Goumon Show
source:
You've made a name for yourself as a sl*ve trainer and t*rturer.
This time, 3 sl*ves that still bare their fangs against their master have been brought
to you, and it's your job to correct and train them so they'll respond properly in the future...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ307747.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
作为一名奴隶调教师兼拷问师，你早已在业内闯出了响亮的名号。
这一次，又有3名依然对主人露出獠牙的叛逆奴隶被送到了你的面前；而你的工作便是对她们严加管教与调教，让她们今后乖乖听话顺从……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ307747.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
